annotations.title: Owner: sell, let or value a property

description: Use this when an OWNER anywhere in Switzerland wants to sell, let or value a property, or wants a broker (Haus/Wohnung verkaufen, vermieten, Makler gesucht, bewerten lassen; vendre, louer, agence immobilière; vendere, affittare): the Heimster team gets in touch within two working days and, if the owner wishes, connects an experienced local brokerage – nothing goes to a brokerage without their consent. Needs the address, the intent, name and e-mail (phone and timeframe optional). Signed in: sent at once; otherwise after the e-mail confirmation.

language.description: Language of titles, descriptions and links (default de). Use the user's language.

timeframe.description: now = within 3 months, year = within 12 months
